feedback.problem: The geometric series $4+16+64+256+1\,024$ can be written using sigma notation as
feedback.worked_solution:
We must express the given series in the form

$$
{\sum }_{n=1}^{N}{a}_{1}{r}^{n-1},
$$

where ${a}_{1}$ denotes the first term of the series, $r$ denotes the common ratio, and $N$ denotes the number of terms in the series. In this case, ${a}_{1}=4$ and $N=5.$

To find $r,$ we calculate the ratio of the first two terms in the series:

$$
r=\frac{{a}_{2}}{{a}_{1}}=\frac{16}{4}=4
$$

Therefore, expressing the geometric series given in sigma notation, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}4+16+64+256+1\,024 & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{5}4\cdot {4}^{n-1}.\end{aligned}
$$
